chunks: And Allah created every moving creature from water; so among them are those that crawl on their bellies, and among them are those that walk on two legs, and among them are those that walk on four. Allah creates what He wills. Indeed, Allah is All-Powerful over all things.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the origin of living creatures and their modes of movement?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as highlighting the biological origin of all creatures from water, a concept aligning with modern scientific understanding of life's genesis. The diversity in locomotion—crawling, bipedal, and quadrupedal—serves as a sign of Allah's creative power, with the 'bipedal' category frequently understood to include humans, distinguishing them by their unique mode of movement and intellect. This verse underscores the unity of creation in origin while emphasizing the diversity in form, reflecting God's absolute will and power.
